text:
elaine: quick probe — trying lazy KV cache + early-return heuristics on llama2-70b-quant. baseline p50 90ms, p99 420ms at batch=1. anyone tried this pattern with GPTQ q4_0?

David: saw something similar on a tiny run last month. main risk is quality regression on long-form outputs (hallucination). suggest adding HELIQA + long_summary checks.

marta: can you paste the exact command/flags? curious about cache TTL and eviction policy.

elaine: command:
```
python -m rwinfer.run --model llama2-70b-quant --quant q4_0 --kv-cache lazy --cache-ttl 30 --early-exit-threshold 0.92 --batch-size 1
```

elaine: quick numbers from a micro-benchmark (n=200): p50 56ms (was 90ms), p99 180ms (was 420ms). token throughput improved but rouge-L on summarization dev set dropped ~0.8 points.

jon: did you keep speculative decoding off for that run? curious if combined gains stack.

elaine: speculative decode disabled to isolate cache effect. next run will enable speculative prefetch window=2.

David: please capture a few failure cases (diffs). also check per-token probs — early-exit can prune high-entropy tokens and cause weird truncation.

elaine: uploaded short diffs + sample logs: https://redwood.link/kv-cache-probe (internal). example line from log:
`[INFO] seq=42 tok=1203 prob=0.0009 early_exit=true`

ops-bot: canary deploy finished for model llama2-70b-quant (canary id c-134). No infra alerts raised. :white_check_mark:

marta: next steps: run 2k evals across SummEval + long Q&A, try q4_triton variant, then re-run with speculative decode + prefetch window=3. assign @jon to collect per-token probs and produce a short regression report.

jon: on it, will also compare beam vs sampling outputs for the failing examples.

elaine: thanks — small note: the early-exit threshold is very sensitive; 0.92 was slightly too aggressive for long summaries. will try 0.96 in the next sweep.
